title: Quantifying AWS S3 I/O Performance Boundaries Using the Roofline Model
problem: Understanding performance characteristics of AWS S3 integration with HPC systems using different access methods and patterns
motivation: Hybrid HPC-cloud environments need clear guidance on S3 integration strategies to avoid suboptimal data transfer approaches
method: Roofline-based analysis of three S3 integration approaches: NFS-mounted Storage Gateway, data migration through Storage Gateway, and direct S3 API transfers
key_novelty: Extension of I/O roofline modeling to characterize operational intensity and bandwidth ceilings for cloud storage access patterns
contributions: Extended I/O roofline methodology for cloud storage
Comparative analysis of three S3 integration approaches
Identification of 6.4x performance differences between methods
